title: From Relevant Posts to Attributable Spans: Explicit Symptom Evidence for Depression Questionnaire Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.12900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Longitudinal social-media histories offer an opportunity to assess depression, potentially supporting the inference of standardized depression questionnaire responses. However, this task requires evidence that is semantically relevant to a symptom and attributable to the user, while being sufficiently specific to support an individual questionnaire item. Existing approaches rely on semantic similarity to retrieve posts, which can introduce misleading or non-attributable evidence, particularly in multi-symptom posts and discussions of others' experiences. We propose SREE (Symptom Retrieval and Evidence-Grounded InfErence), an evidence-grounded pipeline that extracts first-person and symptom-specific text spans, selects a representative subset using a Facility Location-inspired objective, and performs Evidence-Gated Inference over the selected evidence. translated_title: 从相关帖文到可归因文本片段：用于抑郁症问卷推断的显式症状证据
translated_abstract: 纵向的社交媒体历史记录为评估抑郁症提供了机会，有望支持对标准化抑郁症问卷回答的推断。然而，这一任务所需的证据既要在语义上与症状相关，又要能够归因于用户本人，同时还需足够具体以支撑单个问卷条目的推断。现有方法依赖语义相似度来检索帖子，这可能引入误导性或不可归因的证据，尤其是在包含多种症状的帖子和讨论他人经历的场景中。我们提出了SREE（Symptom Retrieval and Evidence-Grounded InfErence，症状检索与证据支撑推断），这是一个基于证据的流水线：它提取第一人称且症状特定的文本片段，使用受设施选址启发的目标函数选择代表性证据子集，并在所选证据上执行证据门控推断。我们在BDI-Sen数据集上评估证据检索效果以及证据条件下的问卷推断……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 提出SREE证据驱动流水线，通过提取第一人称、症状特异的文本片段，用设施选址思想筛选代表性证据，并采用证据门控推断，从而更可靠地从社交媒体历史推断抑郁症问卷结果。
